independent_argument: R_j is a periodic coarse sup-metric cube of radius ell. Its N_2 graph reader is contained in the periodic sup cube of radius ell+2. If two owners have sup-distance greater than 2ell+6, the triangle inequality prevents an intersection of either radius-(ell+2) reader with the other radius-ell integration cube. The condition is conservative; the radius sum is only 2ell+2.

All conflicting distinct underlying free links lie over a sup cube of radius 2ell+6, containing at most (4ell+13)^4 owners. At most m0 free links are owned by each block. Greedy deletion therefore retains at least s/[m0(4ell+13)^4] links from any s distinct underlying-link witnesses.

Periodic wrapping and short tori, including T=2, only reduce the number of owners. If a region fills the torus there are no exterior forcing terms, and the earlier full-torus conditional argument applies.
Repeated colour labels or threshold levels on the same underlying link must first be coalesced as the source explicitly requires. The power-four packing loss remains O(log(u)^4).
